about: The RMR Group Inc., through its subsidiary, provides real estate asset management services in the United States. The company offers management services to publicly traded equity real estate investment trusts; diversified healthcare trust, which owns senior living communities, medical office and life science properties and other healthcare related properties; industrial logistics properties trusts that owns and leases industrial and logistics properties; office properties income trust which owns and leases office properties primarily to single tenants and those with high credit quality characteristics; and service properties trust. It also provides advisory services to publicly traded mortgage real estate investment trust. In addition, the company provides management services to franchisor and operator of hotels, resorts and cruise ships; private funds, joint ventures and the underlying residential real estate assets of the funds, as well as property management services to third party owners; and private capital vehicles, including ABP trust and other private entities that own commercial real estate. The company was formerly known as REIT Management & Research Inc. and changed its name to The RMR Group Inc. in October 2015. The RMR Group Inc. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts.
